      "name": "NARRATOR",
      "age_range": "adult",

  ],
  "segments": {
    "1": [
      "Yeah, I mean.",
      "All I can really smell",
      "is the stench of your rarefied guilty conscience."
    ],
    "5": [
      "Just getting your attention.",
      "Look, you didn't play by the rules,",
      "and someone got hurt.",
      "But he wasn't playing by the rules either.",
      "Ok, if he wasn't illegal, you would have taken him to hospital."
    ],
    "7": [
      "You think you're the only one with guilty secrets?",
      "That story that I tell about my parents?",
      "Even I've started to believe it."
    ],
    "9": [
      "I was having a shitty week, and I wanted to blow off some steam,",
      "so I got in touch with some random dealer.",
      "He turned up.",
      "I got in the car.",
      "We drove around the block a few times.",
      "Got chatting.",
      "Did a couple of bumps together.",
      "But I wasn't thinking straight.",
      "My parents were away and I invited him inside.",
      "He must've seen the house and seen how easy it was to get in.",
      "He cased the place and came back two weeks later.",
      "I brought him to this house, Alexi.",
      "And he tried to rob us and my dad caught him and then he killed both of my parents."
    ],
    "11": [
      "The police identified fingerprints and then they showed me a photo.",
      "The guy pleaded guilty and the case never went to trial",
      "and he didn't mention me, either.",
      "Must be some kind of drug dealer code.",
      "I've never told anyone."
    ],
    "13": [
      "Nothing.",
      "There's nothing to say."
    ]
  }
}
